intent: A microphone whose media clock runs slow in two bursts: 60 s of contiguous RTP timestamps read over 61.28 s, with sender reports every 5 s that show it. Every frame must be written near where it was read, so the audio keeps the wall-clock timeline its video follows. The largest lag is a burst's onset, corrected once a report shows it: one report interval of the worst rate (5 s x 4.5 % = 225 ms) plus a frame. Corrections are 120 ms gaps inserted once the lag reaches 40 ms, so at the end the last frame is within 80 ms of its place. RED: a writer that takes the timeline from RTP timestamps alone plays the last frame 1.28 s early.
